title: Money Mod+
description: Money Mod+ adds a money-stuffed quest system, black market, player rankings, and financial rewards in War Wars and Monsters, with prizes up to $1 million. It supports Minecraft 1.20.1 and requires Money Mod to function.
body:
Money Mod+

Money Mod+ is an expansion addon designed to enhance the economy system by adding new ways to earn, spend, and compete for money. The mod transforms money from a simple currency into a complete progression system filled with challenges, rewards, rankings, and exclusive purchases.

Complete Quest System

Money Mod+ introduces a quest system that gives players objectives to complete while playing. Instead of earning money through only basic methods, players can take on various challenges and receive cash rewards for finishing them.

Quests encourage exploration, combat, and long-term progression by rewarding players for their achievements. As players complete more objectives, they can build their fortune and unlock access to more expensive items and rewards.

Earn Money Through Gameplay

The mod rewards active gameplay by granting money for completing specific tasks and achievements.

Players can receive rewards ranging from small starter payments to massive endgame payouts, including:

$300
$400
$500
$1,000
$1,500
$2,000
$5,000
$10,000
$500,000
$1,000,000

These rewards make progression feel meaningful and provide clear goals for players who want to become the wealthiest members of a server.

Competitive Leaderboards

Money Mod+ adds a leaderboard system that allows players to compare their wealth and achievements with others.

Using dedicated commands, players can:

Check their rank.
View the richest players.
Compete for the top position.
Track their progress against other players.

This creates a competitive environment where earning money becomes more than just a personal goal.

Black Market System

One of the most unique features of Money Mod+ is the Black Market.

The Black Market offers special items that can be purchased using in-game money. These items are designed to give players additional goals after becoming wealthy.

Instead of collecting money without a purpose, players can invest their fortune into rare and powerful equipment.

The market includes exclusive purchases and special gear that cannot be obtained through normal progression alone.

Legendary Equipment

The mod includes special items available through the Black Market.

One example is:

Legendary Dark Sword

This powerful item gives wealthy players something valuable to work toward and serves as a symbol of progress and success.

Ender Dragon Announcements

Money Mod+ celebrates major achievements by broadcasting important events to the entire server.

When a player defeats the Ender Dragon, a special announcement is displayed to all players, recognizing the achievement and highlighting the player responsible for the victory.

This feature helps create memorable moments and makes important accomplishments feel more significant.

Multiplayer Friendly

The mod is designed to work especially well on multiplayer servers.

Server owners can create a more engaging economy by combining:

Money rewards
Quests
Competition
Rankings
Special items
Economic progression

This encourages players to remain active and participate in server activities for longer periods of time.

Commands

The mod includes useful commands such as:

/quests

View available quests and progress.

/rank

Check your personal ranking.

/top

View the server leaderboard.

Additional commands may be available depending on server configuration and future updates.

Why Use Money Mod+?

Money Mod+ adds purpose to earning money.

Instead of simply collecting currency, players can complete quests, compete with others, climb leaderboards, unlock exclusive rewards, purchase special items from the Black Market, and work toward becoming the richest player on the server.

Whether you're playing solo or with friends, Money Mod+ provides a deeper economic experience, rewarding progression, competitive gameplay, and long-term goals for every player.

Supported Version: Minecraft 1.20.1
Developer: NaifHani
Required Dependency: Money Mod
Version: 1.0.0+
